rockhall_warden.text: Welcome to Rockhall! Built right into the rock, this place. The back wall IS the Roaches.
It's a climbers' hut now, named after Don Whillans, a little Salford plumber who climbed like he was arguing with the rock and winning.
Gritstone's grippy as sandpaper. Lovely to climb, murder on your hands. Tea's in the pot. Help yourself, wash your mug.
